stem.text: A particle moves along the \( x \)-axis. Its velocity, in meters per second, is \( v(t) \) for \( 0 \le t \le 12 \) seconds, where \[ v(t) = \begin{cases} 2t & \text{for } 0 \le t \le 2 \\ 4 & \text{for } 2 < t \le 4 \\ 12 - 2t & \text{for } 4 < t \le 6 \\ -\sqrt{4 - (t - 8)^{2}} & \text{for } 6 < t \le 10 \\ t - 10 & \text{for } 10 < t \le 12 \end{cases} \] so the graph of \( v \) consists of four line segments and a semicircle below the \( t \)-axis. At time \( t = 0 \) the particle is at position \( x = -5 \).

worked_solution.text: A triangle on [0, 2], a rectangle on [2, 4] and a triangle on [4, 6], all above the axis.
A semicircle of radius 2 below the axis on [6, 10] and a triangle above the axis on [10, 12].

points.criterion: Gives 16 as the sum of the triangle, rectangle and triangle areas on [0, 6].
Gives 2 - 2pi, the signed semicircle area -2pi plus the triangle area 2. Any exact equivalent is accepted; counting the semicircle as positive does not earn the point.

parts.prompt: Find the position of the particle at time \( t = 12 \). Find the total distance the particle travels during the interval \( 0 \le t \le 12 \).

worked_solution.text: Initial position plus displacement over [0, 12], using part (a).
Total distance adds the unsigned areas.

points.criterion: Gives the position 13 - 2pi, the initial position -5 plus the displacement 18 - 2pi. Any exact equivalent is accepted.
Gives the total distance 18 + 2pi, with the semicircle area counted as positive. Any exact equivalent is accepted.

worked_solution.text: Over [4, 12] the signed areas are 4, -2pi and 2; reversing the limits changes the sign.
Over [2, 10] the signed areas are 8, 4 and -2pi.
Linearity, with the integral of the constant 1 over an interval of length 8.

points.criterion: Gives 2pi - 6, the negative of the signed area on [4, 12]. Any exact equivalent is accepted; 6 - 2pi does not earn the point.
Gives 28 - 6pi, three times the signed area 12 - 2pi on [2, 10] minus 8. Any exact equivalent is accepted.

parts.prompt: Let \( A(x) = \displaystyle\int_{2}^{x} v(t)\,dt \) for \( 0 \le x \le 12 \). Find \( A(0) \) and \( A(10) \). Find the average value of \( v(t) \) on the interval \( 0 \le t \le 10 \).

worked_solution.text: Reversed limits over the triangle on [0, 2].
The signed area on [2, 10] from part (c).
The signed area on [0, 10] divided by the length 10.

points.criterion: Gives A(0) = -4, with the sign reversed for the reversed limits.
Gives A(10) = 12 - 2pi. Any exact equivalent is accepted.
Gives the average value (8 - pi)/5, the signed area 16 - 2pi divided by 10. Any exact equivalent is accepted.
